q_fto2_nc.template:
-- FTO2 NC dashboard, level 2 (connection check): one row per NC, generated by build/dummy_tables.py.
-- Fictitious data made by the query itself: no dataset needed. Paste as a Slate query on the Postgres source
-- (postgate-airbus-2), name it q_fto2_nc; the code sandbox's state reads it.
WITH
-- Fictitious FTO2 NC data, columns of the datasets fto2_dash_nc and fto2_dash_defects. No real NC: numbers 900000001...,
-- MSNs, FINs (X..VT) and texts are made up; categories, cost rules and codes are the real ones. Same data at every run.
tax (sub, cat, rca, minor, minutes, material, code, cable_pct, lo, hi) AS (VALUES
    ('Inversion', 'Erreur Branchement', 'Inversion', 0, 35.0, 0.0, 'T04', 1, 0, 1552),
    ('Erreur de branchement', 'Erreur Branchement', 'Mauvaise Borne', 0, 35.0, 0.0, 'T02', 0, 1553, 2605),
    ('Déverrouillage', 'Déverrouillage', 'Déverrouillage', 0, 10.0, 0.0, 'Q01-001', 0, 2606, 3109),
    ('Non connecté', 'Erreur Branchement', 'Non Connecté', 0, 35.0, 0.0, 'T05', 8, 3110, 3148),
    ('Frettage / colliers – pose', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Frettage Incorrect', 0, 1.0, 1.3, 'Q05-004', 0, 3149, 3761),
    ('Serrage électrique', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Serrage Incorrect', 0, 3.0, 0.0, 'Q05-001', 0, 3762, 3945),
    ('Serrage mécanique', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Serrage Incorrect', 0, 3.0, 0.52, 'Q05-002', 0, 3946, 4045),
    ('Cheminement – longueur / tension', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Mauvais Cheminement', 0, 2.0, 7.2, 'Q06-001', 12, 4046, 4484),
    ('Câble à refaire (ligne)', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Mauvais Cheminement', 0, 60.0, 0.0, 'Q06-001', 100, 4485, 4684),
    ('Cheminement – clash', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Mauvais Cheminement', 0, 1.0, 0.0, 'Q06-004', 0, 4685, 4878),
    ('Gainage / protection', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'MEO Gainage', 0, 5.0, 3.58, 'Q06-002', 0, 4879, 5304),
    ('Identification – positionnement', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Finition Inachevée', 0, 2.0, 45.2, 'Q06-010', 0, 5305, 5485),
    ('Câblage non terminé', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Finition Inachevée', 0, 2.0, 63.77, 'Q06-009', 0, 5486, 5521),
    ('Sertissage', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Défaut de Sertissage sur câble standard', 0, 1.0, 0.0, 'Q07-001', 7, 5522, 5666),
    ('Sertissage spécifique', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Défaut de Sertissage sur câble spécifique', 0, 10.0, 0.0, 'Q08-001', 5, 5667, 5727),
    ('Mauvaise réf. – colliers / frettage', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Erreur Fixation ou Protection', 0, 6.0, 0.0, 'Q04-007', 0, 5728, 5853),
    ('Mauvaise réf. – identification', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Erreur Fixation ou Protection', 0, 4.0, 4.43, 'Q04-013', 0, 5854, 5947),
    ('Mauvaise réf. – mécanique', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Erreur Fixation ou Protection', 0, 4.0, 0.0, 'Q04-003', 0, 5948, 6173),
    ('Mauvaise réf. – obturation / thermo', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Erreur Fixation ou Protection', 0, 2.0, 0.0, 'Q04-001', 0, 6174, 6234),
    ('Mauvaise réf. – électrique / détrompage', 'MEO Facteur humain', 'Erreur Composant Électrique', 0, 30.0, 0.18, 'Q04-004', 1, 6235, 6667),
    ('Manquant – colliers', 'Élément Manquant', 'Fixation ou Protection Manquante', 1, 3.0, 0.0, 'Q03-006', 0, 6668, 7058),
    ('Manquant – gaine / thermo', 'Élément Manquant', 'Fixation ou Protection Manquante', 0, 1.0, 0.0, 'Q03-002', 0, 7059, 7113),
    ('Manquant – mécanique / freinage', 'Élément Manquant', 'Fixation ou Protection Manquante', 0, 2.0, 0.0, 'Q03-003', 0, 7114, 7190),
    ('Manquant – obturateurs / bouchons', 'Élément Manquant', 'Obturateur Manquant', 1, 1.0, 0.0, 'Q03-001', 0, 7191, 7384),
    ('Manquant – câble / shunt / élément', 'Élément Manquant', 'Câble ou Élément Manquant', 0, 15.0, 0.0, 'Q03-004', 75, 7385, 7646),
    ('Manquant – identification', 'Élément Manquant', 'Identification Manquante', 0, 2.0, 0.0, 'Q03-009', 0, 7647, 7769),
    ('Dommage – câble', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Câble Endommagé', 0, 30.0, 2.01, 'Q11-001', 99, 7770, 8001),
    ('Dommage – composant cassé', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Composant Endommagé', 0, 30.0, 0.0, 'Q11-003', 0, 8002, 8382),
    ('Composant HS', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Composant Endommagé', 0, 30.0, 0.0, 'Q11 (composant)', 0, 8383, 8592),
    ('Composant – cause non écrite', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Composant Endommagé', 0, 30.0, 0.0, 'Q11 (composant)', 0, 8593, 8731),
    ('Dommage – tresse de masse', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Composant Endommagé', 0, 10.0, 0.0, 'Q11-009', 0, 8732, 8741),
    ('Dommage – identification', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Protection Endommagée', 0, 4.0, 1.32, 'Q11-002', 0, 8742, 8873),
    ('Dommage – habillage', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Protection Endommagée', 0, 2.0, 0.0, 'Q11-004', 0, 8874, 8925),
    ('Dommage – structure', 'Élément Endommagé', 'Structure Endommagée', 0, 20.0, 0.85, 'Q10-001', 0, 8926, 9206),
    ('Bleu non appliqué', 'Grounding/Bonding', 'Défaut de Métallisation', 0, 2.0, 0.0, 'Q09-001', 0, 9207, 9400),
    ('Bleu mal appliqué / débordant', 'Grounding/Bonding', 'Défaut de Métallisation', 0, 10.0, 0.0, 'Q09-002', 0, 9401, 9545),
    ('Point de masse / mesure', 'Grounding/Bonding', 'Défaut de Métallisation', 0, 5.0, 0.0, 'Q09-003', 0, 9546, 9574),
    ('Amont · Câble', 'Kitting Factory', 'Défaut d''Impression', 0, 5.0, 0.0, 'Q12-001', 100, 9575, 9687),
    ('Amont · Identification / barrette VT', 'Kitting Factory', 'Défaut d''Impression', 0, 5.0, 0.0, 'Q12-005', 4, 9688, 9771),
    ('Dossier', 'Autre', 'Erreur Dossier', 0, 2.0, 0.0, 'Q13-001', 0, 9772, 9871),
    ('FOD', 'FOD', 'FOD', 0, 5.0, 0.0, 'Q16-001', 0, 9872, 9948),
    ('Non classé', 'Autre', 'Autre', 0, 10.0, 0.0, 'Non codé', 0, 9949, 9999)
),
rules (rule, alert, write, support, work, recheck, eng_hours, label, airbus) AS (VALUES
    ('RWK', 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0.0, 'Rework to drawing', 542.42),
    ('EXC', 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0.0, 'Exchange', 542.42),
    ('REJ', 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0.0, 'Rejection', 252.27),
    ('REJ_RW', 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0.0, 'Rejection with a rework order', 252.27),
    ('SCR', 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0.0, 'Scrap', 252.27),
    ('DQN', 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 8.0, 'Request for design change', 951.33),
    ('ACC', 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0.0, 'Accept as is', 252.27),
    ('PNC', 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0.0, 'Potential non-conformity', 252.27),
    ('NDC', 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0.0, 'No decision', 69.56),
    ('DELETED', 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0.0, 'Deleted NC', 69.56),
    ('UNKNOWN', 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0.0, 'Unknown decision code', 69.56)
),
days AS (   -- working days; fewer NCs in July and August, almost none during the August shutdown
    SELECT g::date AS day, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY g) AS di
    FROM generate_series(date '2026-01-05', date '2026-09-25', interval '1 day') AS t(g)
    WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) < 6
),
counts AS (
    SELECT day, CASE WHEN day BETWEEN date '2026-08-03' AND date '2026-08-21' THEN (('x' || substr(md5('sd:' || (di)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 2)
                     WHEN extract(month FROM day) IN (7, 8) THEN 1 + (('x' || substr(md5('su:' || (di)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 4)
                     ELSE 2 + (('x' || substr(md5('dd:' || (di)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 5) END AS k
    FROM days
),
base AS (
    SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.day, s.j) AS i, c.day
    FROM counts c CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, c.k) AS s(j)
),
n0 AS (   -- one row per NC: line, perimeter, type, decision
    SELECT i, day, (900000000 + i)::text AS nc,
        CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ln:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 46 THEN 'A350' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ln:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 84 THEN 'A330' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ln:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 93 THEN 'A400M' ELSE 'A320' END AS line,
        CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 74 THEN 'FTO2' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 81 THEN 'Retour client' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 92 THEN 'Supprimée'
             WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 97 THEN 'Fournisseur' ELSE 'Hors périmètre' END AS plant_scope,
        (('x' || substr(md5('ty:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ty, (('x' || substr(md5('ru:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ru, (('x' || substr(md5('ph:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ph, (('x' || substr(md5('nl:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_nl, (('x' || substr(md5('nl2:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_nl2, (('x' || substr(md5('pr:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_pr, (('x' || substr(md5('hr:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_hr,
        (('x' || substr(md5('op:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_op, (('x' || substr(md5('ld:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ld, (('x' || substr(md5('ld2:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ld2, (('x' || substr(md5('so:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_so, (('x' || substr(md5('sd2:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_sd, (('x' || substr(md5('sg:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_sg, (('x' || substr(md5('sc:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_sc
    FROM base
),
n1 AS (
    SELECT n0.*,
        CASE plant_scope WHEN 'Retour client' THEN 'client' WHEN 'Fournisseur' THEN 'autre' WHEN 'Hors périmètre' THEN 'autre' ELSE 'serie' END AS scope,
        CASE plant_scope WHEN 'Retour client' THEN 'FFF1' WHEN 'Fournisseur' THEN 'FNZ1' WHEN 'Hors périmètre' THEN 'TOF' ELSE 'FTO2' END AS plant,
        CASE WHEN plant_scope IN ('FTO2', 'Retour client', 'Supprimée') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_aec,
        CASE WHEN plant_scope = 'Retour client' THEN 'NC Retour client' WHEN plant_scope = 'Fournisseur' THEN 'FOURNISSEUR'
             WHEN u_ty < 30 THEN 'CABLES' WHEN u_ty < 57 THEN 'TEST' WHEN u_ty < 75 THEN 'INTERNE' WHEN u_ty < 89 THEN 'CONTROLE FINAL'
             WHEN u_ty < 94 THEN 'NC Interne' WHEN u_ty < 97 THEN 'CASSE INTERNE' WHEN u_ty < 99 THEN 'DAMAGES' ELSE 'DEMANDE DE DQN' END AS type_nc,
        CASE WHEN u_ph < 90 THEN 'SERIE' WHEN u_ph < 97 THEN 'REC' ELSE 'FTI' END AS phase,
        CASE WHEN u_nl < 8 THEN 0 WHEN u_nl < 72 THEN 1 WHEN u_nl < 82 THEN 2 WHEN u_nl < 88 THEN 3 WHEN u_nl < 92 THEN 4 + u_nl2 % 2
             WHEN u_nl < 96 THEN 6 + u_nl2 % 4 ELSE 10 + u_nl2 % 5 END AS k
    FROM n0
),
n1b AS (
    SELECT n1.*,
        CASE WHEN plant_scope = 'Supprimée' THEN 'DELETED' WHEN type_nc = 'DEMANDE DE DQN' THEN 'DQN'
             WHEN u_ru < 78 THEN 'RWK' WHEN u_ru < 88 THEN 'REJ_RW' WHEN u_ru < 94 THEN 'REJ' WHEN u_ru < 98 THEN 'EXC' WHEN u_ru < 99 THEN 'NDC' ELSE 'SCR' END AS rule,
        CASE line WHEN 'A350' THEN 700 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 6
                  WHEN 'A330' THEN 2100 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 5
                  WHEN 'A400M' THEN 150 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 4
                  ELSE 13000 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 3 END AS msn_n
    FROM n1
),
d0 AS (   -- one row per defect line
    SELECT n.i, n.nc, s.seq, n.scope, n.type_nc, n.line,
        (('x' || substr(md5('sb:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 10000) AS u_sb, (('x' || substr(md5('cb:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_cb, (('x' || substr(md5('fn:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 1000) AS u_fn, (('x' || substr(md5('fn2:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 1000) AS u_fn2, (('x' || substr(md5('fe:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_fe,
        (('x' || substr(md5('qt:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_qt, (('x' || substr(md5('lb:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_lb, (('x' || substr(md5('cf:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_cf, (('x' || substr(md5('dt:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_dt
    FROM n1b n CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, n.k) AS s(seq)
),
d1 AS (
    SELECT d0.*, t.sub, t.cat, t.rca, t.minor, t.minutes, t.material, t.code,
        CASE WHEN u_cb < t.cable_pct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cable,
        CASE WHEN u_qt < 98 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS qty,
        CASE WHEN u_fe < 22 THEN '' ELSE 'X' || lpad(least(u_fn % 40, u_fn2 % 40)::text, 2, '0') || 'VT' END AS fin,
        CASE WHEN t.sub IN ('Inversion', 'Erreur de branchement', 'Non connecté') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_conn
    FROM d0 JOIN tax t ON d0.u_sb BETWEEN t.lo AND t.hi
),
d2 AS (   -- minutes of each line: the first connection error of an NC at its class time, each following one 15 min
    SELECT d1.*,
        CASE WHEN is_conn = 1 AND sum(is_conn * qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i ORDER BY seq) - is_conn * qty >= 1 THEN 15 * qty
             WHEN is_conn = 1 THEN minutes + 15 * (qty - 1)
             ELSE minutes * qty END AS line_min,
        material * qty AS line_mat,
        CASE WHEN scope = 'client' THEN (ARRAY['During installation', 'During PNE inspection', 'During the unpacking', 'During ground test', 'During inspection'])[1 + u_dt % 5] ELSE '' END AS cr_detection
    FROM d1
),
agg AS (
    SELECT i, sum(line_min) AS mins, sum(line_mat) AS mat, max(cable) AS cable, count(*) AS lines
    FROM d2 GROUP BY i
),
firsts AS (
    SELECT i, sub AS first_sub, cr_detection AS first_det FROM d2 WHERE seq = 1
),
n2 AS (   -- the NC with the CNQ model's minutes and costs
    SELECT n.*, r.label AS decision_label, r.airbus, r.eng_hours,
        coalesce(a.lines, 0) AS lines, coalesce(a.cable, 0) AS cable, f.first_sub, f.first_det,
        r.alert * CASE WHEN upper(n.type_nc) IN ('TEST', 'CONTROLE FINAL') AND n.scope <> 'client' THEN 0 ELSE 41 END AS m_alert,
        r.write * CASE WHEN n.type_nc = 'CONTROLE FINAL' THEN 60 ELSE 30 END AS m_write,
        r.support * 60 AS m_support,
        r.recheck * 30 AS m_recheck,
        CASE WHEN upper(n.type_nc) IN ('INTERNE', 'NC INTERNE') THEN 2.0 ELSE 1 END AS factor,
        CASE WHEN coalesce(a.lines, 0) = 0 THEN 10 ELSE a.mins END AS hands,
        CASE WHEN r.work = 1 THEN coalesce(a.mat, 0) ELSE 0 END AS mat,
        r.work, r.write, r.support, r.recheck, r.alert
    FROM n1b n JOIN rules r ON r.rule = n.rule
    LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.i = n.i LEFT JOIN firsts f ON f.i = n.i
),
n3 AS (
    SELECT n2.*,
        work * factor * greatest(50, 60 - hands) AS m_setup,
        work * factor * hands AS m_hands,
        (SELECT max(day) FROM base) AS last_day
    FROM n2
),
n4 AS (
    SELECT n3.*,
        CASE WHEN rule = 'DELETED' THEN 'deleted' WHEN u_op < 7 AND day > last_day - 75 THEN 'open' WHEN u_op < 1 THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END AS status,
        least((CASE WHEN u_ld < 40 THEN 1 + u_ld2 % 5 WHEN u_ld < 70 THEN 5 + u_ld2 % 10 WHEN u_ld < 88 THEN 15 + u_ld2 % 20
                    WHEN u_ld < 96 THEN 35 + u_ld2 % 30 ELSE 65 + u_ld2 % 40 END) + u_ld2 / 100.0, last_day - day) AS lead
    FROM n3
)
SELECT
    nc,
    to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created,
    line,
    plant,
    on_aec,
    rule,
    decision_label,
    CASE WHEN scope = 'client' THEN 'Customer return' WHEN type_nc = 'CONTROLE FINAL' THEN 'Final inspection' WHEN type_nc = 'CABLES' THEN 'Cables'
         WHEN type_nc = 'TEST' THEN 'TEST' WHEN type_nc = 'INTERNE' THEN 'In-process (internal)' WHEN type_nc = 'FOURNISSEUR' THEN 'Supplier'
         WHEN type_nc = 'CASSE INTERNE' THEN 'Breakage' WHEN type_nc = 'DAMAGES' THEN 'Damage' WHEN type_nc = 'DEMANDE DE DQN' THEN 'Design query request'
         ELSE type_nc END AS where_found,
    airbus AS cost_airbus,
    round(((alert * CASE WHEN m_alert > 0 THEN 41 ELSE 0 END * 123.0 + write * 30 * 107.0 + support * 60 * 76.0 + work * 60 * 123.0
            + recheck * 30 * 107.0) / 60.0 + eng_hours * 78.16 + mat)::numeric, 2) AS cost_global,
    round(((m_alert * 123.0 + m_write * 107.0 + m_support * 76.0 + (m_setup + m_hands) * 123.0 + m_recheck * 107.0) / 60.0 + eng_hours * 78.16 + mat)::numeric, 2) AS cost_total,
    round(((m_alert * 123.0 + m_write * 107.0 + m_support * 76.0 + m_recheck * 107.0) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) AS cost_admin,
    round(((m_setup + m_hands) / 60.0 * 123.0)::numeric, 2) AS cost_work,
    round(mat::numeric, 2) AS cost_material,
    round((eng_hours * 78.16)::numeric, 2) AS cost_engineering,
    cable,
    lines AS defect_lines,
    'Fictif – ' || coalesce(first_sub, 'NC sans ligne de défaut') || ' – ' || line AS title,
    scope,
    phase,
    msn_n::text AS msn,
    CASE line WHEN 'A350' THEN CASE WHEN u_pr < 70 THEN 'MIP A350' WHEN u_pr < 82 THEN 'MDCD' ELSE 'Other' END
              WHEN 'A330' THEN CASE WHEN u_pr < 50 THEN 'PTVU' WHEN u_pr < 90 THEN '740VU' ELSE '742VU' END
              WHEN 'A400M' THEN CASE WHEN u_pr < 55 THEN 'MIP A400M' WHEN u_pr < 85 THEN '300VU' ELSE 'OHP' END
              ELSE CASE WHEN u_pr < 60 THEN 'E-RUDDER' ELSE 'MFRL' END END AS product,
    CASE WHEN type_nc = 'TEST' THEN 'Test électrique' WHEN type_nc = 'CONTROLE FINAL' THEN 'Contrôle final' ELSE CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('st:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 6) = 0 THEN 'Poste câblage A' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('st:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 6) = 1 THEN 'Poste câblage B' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('st:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 6) = 2 THEN 'Sous-ensemble harnais' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('st:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 6) = 3 THEN 'Intégration' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('st:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 6) = 4 THEN 'Retouche ligne' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('st:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 6) = 5 THEN 'Finition' ELSE 'Finition' END END AS station,
    CASE WHEN u_hr < 4 THEN 8 WHEN u_hr < 16 THEN 9 WHEN u_hr < 34 THEN 10 WHEN u_hr < 48 THEN 11 WHEN u_hr < 58 THEN 12 WHEN u_hr < 65 THEN 13
         WHEN u_hr < 73 THEN 14 WHEN u_hr < 84 THEN 15 WHEN u_hr < 92 THEN 16 WHEN u_hr < 95 THEN 17 WHEN u_hr < 98 THEN 22 ELSE 23 END AS hour,
    CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN lead END AS lead_days,
    CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_open,
    CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN (last_day - day) + 0.5 END AS age_days,
    CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN to_char(day + lead::int, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS closed,
    type_nc,
    CASE plant_scope WHEN 'Fournisseur' THEN '148971' WHEN 'Hors périmètre' THEN 'TO' ELSE 'FTO2' END AS liability,
    CASE WHEN u_sd < 50 THEN 'Electrical Assembly Installation' WHEN u_sd < 65 THEN 'Harness' WHEN u_sd < 75 THEN 'Structural and Mechanical Assembly'
         WHEN u_sd < 83 THEN 'Broken' WHEN u_sd < 90 THEN 'Incorrect connector' ELSE 'Missing part' END AS sap_defect,
    CASE WHEN u_sg < 65 THEN 'Human Factors' WHEN u_sg < 90 THEN 'Jigs, Tools, Machines, Programs & Protec' WHEN u_sg < 95 THEN 'Supplier Issue'
         ELSE 'Process and Method' END AS sap_cause_group,
    CASE WHEN u_sc < 55 THEN 'People' WHEN u_sc < 70 THEN 'Defect/Damaged/Broken' WHEN u_sc < 80 THEN 'Accident' WHEN u_sc < 90 THEN 'Wrong / unsuitable'
         ELSE 'Malfunction' END AS sap_cause,
    status,
    CASE WHEN u_so < 60 THEN 'gps' WHEN u_so < 80 THEN 'sky' ELSE 'test' END AS source,
    m_alert AS min_alert,
    m_write AS min_writing,
    m_support AS min_support,
    m_setup AS min_setup,
    m_hands AS min_hands_on,
    m_recheck AS min_recheck,
    eng_hours AS hours_engineering,
    CASE WHEN type_nc = 'CONTROLE FINAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS final_inspection,
    CASE WHEN scope = 'client' THEN 'Texte fictif de retour client.' || chr(10) || 'Moment of Detection : ' || coalesce(first_det, '')
         || chr(10) || 'Description : défaut constaté chez le client (donnée fictive).' ELSE '' END AS long_text,
    CASE WHEN m_setup + m_hands > 0 THEN 'model' ELSE '' END AS work_source,
    '' AS order_state,
    '' AS rework_orders,
    CASE WHEN m_alert > 0 THEN 'flat' ELSE '' END AS alert_source,
    '' AS aleas,
    CASE WHEN u_so >= 92 THEN 'missing_ids' ELSE 'normal' END AS origin
FROM n4
ORDER BY nc

),
days AS (   -- working days; fewer NCs in July and August, almost none during the August shutdown

),
counts AS (
    SELECT day, CASE WHEN day BETWEEN date '2026-08-03' AND date '2026-08-21' THEN (('x' || substr(md5('sd:' || (di)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 2)
                     WHEN extract(month FROM day) IN (7, 8) THEN 1 + (('x' || substr(md5('su:' || (di)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 4)

    FROM days
),
base AS (
    SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.day, s.j) AS i, c.day
    FROM counts c CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, c.k) AS s(j)
),
n0 AS (   -- one row per NC: line, perimeter, type, decision
    SELECT i, day, (900000000 + i)::text AS nc,
        CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ln:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 46 THEN 'A350' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ln:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 84 THEN 'A330' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ln:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 93 THEN 'A400M' ELSE 'A320' END AS line,
        CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 74 THEN 'FTO2' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 81 THEN 'Retour client' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 92 THEN 'Supprimée'
             WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('ps:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 97 THEN 'Fournisseur' ELSE 'Hors périmètre' END AS plant_scope,
        (('x' || substr(md5('ty:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ty, (('x' || substr(md5('ru:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ru, (('x' || substr(md5('ph:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ph, (('x' || substr(md5('nl:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_nl, (('x' || substr(md5('nl2:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_nl2, (('x' || substr(md5('pr:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_pr, (('x' || substr(md5('hr:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_hr,
        (('x' || substr(md5('op:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_op, (('x' || substr(md5('ld:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ld, (('x' || substr(md5('ld2:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_ld2, (('x' || substr(md5('so:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_so, (('x' || substr(md5('sd2:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_sd, (('x' || substr(md5('sg:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_sg, (('x' || substr(md5('sc:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_sc
    FROM base
),
n1 AS (
    SELECT n0.*,
        CASE plant_scope WHEN 'Retour client' THEN 'client' WHEN 'Fournisseur' THEN 'autre' WHEN 'Hors périmètre' THEN 'autre' ELSE 'serie' END AS scope,
        CASE plant_scope WHEN 'Retour client' THEN 'FFF1' WHEN 'Fournisseur' THEN 'FNZ1' WHEN 'Hors périmètre' THEN 'TOF' ELSE 'FTO2' END AS plant,
        CASE WHEN plant_scope IN ('FTO2', 'Retour client', 'Supprimée') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_aec,
        CASE WHEN plant_scope = 'Retour client' THEN 'NC Retour client' WHEN plant_scope = 'Fournisseur' THEN 'FOURNISSEUR'
             WHEN u_ty < 30 THEN 'CABLES' WHEN u_ty < 57 THEN 'TEST' WHEN u_ty < 75 THEN 'INTERNE' WHEN u_ty < 89 THEN 'CONTROLE FINAL'
             WHEN u_ty < 94 THEN 'NC Interne' WHEN u_ty < 97 THEN 'CASSE INTERNE' WHEN u_ty < 99 THEN 'DAMAGES' ELSE 'DEMANDE DE DQN' END AS type_nc,
        CASE WHEN u_ph < 90 THEN 'SERIE' WHEN u_ph < 97 THEN 'REC' ELSE 'FTI' END AS phase,
        CASE WHEN u_nl < 8 THEN 0 WHEN u_nl < 72 THEN 1 WHEN u_nl < 82 THEN 2 WHEN u_nl < 88 THEN 3 WHEN u_nl < 92 THEN 4 + u_nl2 % 2
             WHEN u_nl < 96 THEN 6 + u_nl2 % 4 ELSE 10 + u_nl2 % 5 END AS k
    FROM n0
),
n1b AS (
    SELECT n1.*,
        CASE WHEN plant_scope = 'Supprimée' THEN 'DELETED' WHEN type_nc = 'DEMANDE DE DQN' THEN 'DQN'
             WHEN u_ru < 78 THEN 'RWK' WHEN u_ru < 88 THEN 'REJ_RW' WHEN u_ru < 94 THEN 'REJ' WHEN u_ru < 98 THEN 'EXC' WHEN u_ru < 99 THEN 'NDC' ELSE 'SCR' END AS rule,
        CASE line WHEN 'A350' THEN 700 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 6
                  WHEN 'A330' THEN 2100 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 5
                  WHEN 'A400M' THEN 150 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 4
                  ELSE 13000 + (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY line ORDER BY i) - 1) / 3 END AS msn_n
    FROM n1
),
d0 AS (   -- one row per defect line
    SELECT n.i, n.nc, s.seq, n.scope, n.type_nc, n.line,
        (('x' || substr(md5('sb:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 10000) AS u_sb, (('x' || substr(md5('cb:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_cb, (('x' || substr(md5('fn:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 1000) AS u_fn, (('x' || substr(md5('fn2:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 1000) AS u_fn2, (('x' || substr(md5('fe:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_fe,
        (('x' || substr(md5('qt:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_qt, (('x' || substr(md5('lb:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_lb, (('x' || substr(md5('cf:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_cf, (('x' || substr(md5('dt:' || (n.i * 100 + s.seq)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) AS u_dt
    FROM n1b n CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, n.k) AS s(seq)
),
d1 AS (
    SELECT d0.*, t.sub, t.cat, t.rca, t.minor, t.minutes, t.material, t.code,
        CASE WHEN u_cb < t.cable_pct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cable,
        CASE WHEN u_qt < 98 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS qty,
        CASE WHEN u_fe < 22 THEN '' ELSE 'X' || lpad(least(u_fn % 40, u_fn2 % 40)::text, 2, '0') || 'VT' END AS fin,
        CASE WHEN t.sub IN ('Inversion', 'Erreur de branchement', 'Non connecté') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_conn
    FROM d0 JOIN tax t ON d0.u_sb BETWEEN t.lo AND t.hi
),
d2 AS (   -- minutes of each line: the first connection error of an NC at its class time, each following one 15 min
    SELECT d1.*,
        CASE WHEN is_conn = 1 AND sum(is_conn * qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i ORDER BY seq) - is_conn * qty >= 1 THEN 15 * qty
             WHEN is_conn = 1 THEN minutes + 15 * (qty - 1)
             ELSE minutes * qty END AS line_min,
        material * qty AS line_mat,
        CASE WHEN scope = 'client' THEN (ARRAY['During installation', 'During PNE inspection', 'During the unpacking', 'During ground test', 'During inspection'])[1 + u_dt % 5] ELSE '' END AS cr_detection
    FROM d1
),
agg AS (
    SELECT i, sum(line_min) AS mins, sum(line_mat) AS mat, max(cable) AS cable, count(*) AS lines
    FROM d2 GROUP BY i
),
firsts AS (
    SELECT i, sub AS first_sub, cr_detection AS first_det FROM d2 WHERE seq = 1
),
n2 AS (   -- the NC with the CNQ model's minutes and costs
    SELECT n.*, r.label AS decision_label, r.airbus, r.eng_hours,
        coalesce(a.lines, 0) AS lines, coalesce(a.cable, 0) AS cable, f.first_sub, f.first_det,
        r.alert * CASE WHEN upper(n.type_nc) IN ('TEST', 'CONTROLE FINAL') AND n.scope <> 'client' THEN 0 ELSE 41 END AS m_alert,
        r.write * CASE WHEN n.type_nc = 'CONTROLE FINAL' THEN 60 ELSE 30 END AS m_write,
        r.support * 60 AS m_support,
        r.recheck * 30 AS m_recheck,
        CASE WHEN upper(n.type_nc) IN ('INTERNE', 'NC INTERNE') THEN 2.0 ELSE 1 END AS factor,
        CASE WHEN coalesce(a.lines, 0) = 0 THEN 10 ELSE a.mins END AS hands,
        CASE WHEN r.work = 1 THEN coalesce(a.mat, 0) ELSE 0 END AS mat,
        r.work, r.write, r.support, r.recheck, r.alert
    FROM n1b n JOIN rules r ON r.rule = n.rule
    LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.i = n.i LEFT JOIN firsts f ON f.i = n.i
),
n3 AS (
    SELECT n2.*,
        work * factor * greatest(50, 60 - hands) AS m_setup,
        work * factor * hands AS m_hands,
        (SELECT max(day) FROM base) AS last_day
    FROM n2
)
SELECT
    d2.nc,
    d2.seq,
    d2.cat,
    d2.rca,
    d2.sub,
    d2.minor,
    d2.cable,
    round(((n3.m_alert * 123.0 + n3.m_write * 107.0 + n3.m_support * 76.0 + (n3.m_setup + n3.m_hands) * 123.0 + n3.m_recheck * 107.0) / 60.0
           + n3.eng_hours * 78.16 + n3.mat)::numeric
          / n3.lines, 2) AS cost_alloc,
    d2.qty,
    'Fictif : ' || lower(d2.sub) || CASE WHEN d2.fin <> '' THEN ' sur ' || d2.fin ELSE '' END || ', à reprendre selon le plan.' AS text,
    d2.code AS subcode,
    d2.fin,
    CASE WHEN d2.u_lb < 93 THEN 'ai' ELSE 'parser' END AS label_src,
    CASE WHEN d2.u_lb >= 93 THEN '' WHEN d2.u_cf < 62 THEN 'high' WHEN d2.u_cf < 96 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS ai_conf,
    CASE WHEN d2.scope <> 'client' OR d2.cat <> 'Élément Endommagé' THEN ''
         WHEN d2.cr_detection ILIKE '%unpacking%' THEN 'recu' WHEN d2.sub = 'Composant HS' THEN 'hs'
         WHEN d2.sub = 'Composant – cause non écrite' THEN 'nc' ELSE 'phys' END AS cr_nature,
    d2.cr_detection,
    CASE WHEN d2.scope = 'client' THEN 'Fictif : ' || lower(d2.sub) ELSE '' END AS cr_symptom
FROM d2 JOIN n3 ON n3.i = d2.i
ORDER BY d2.nc, d2.seq

q_fto2_dis.template:
-- FTO2 NC dashboard, level 2 (connection check): one row per quality aléa with no NC, generated by build/dummy_tables.py.
-- Fictitious data made by the query itself: no dataset needed. Paste as a Slate query on the Postgres source
-- (postgate-airbus-2), name it q_fto2_dis; the code sandbox's state reads it.
-- MES disruptions are made up: ids OZ9..., stations and texts are fictitious. Same data at every run.
WITH days AS (
    SELECT g::date AS day
    FROM generate_series(date '2026-01-05', date '2026-09-25', interval '1 day') AS t(g)
    WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) < 6 AND NOT (g::date BETWEEN date '2026-08-03' AND date '2026-08-21')
),
counts AS (
    SELECT day, CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('dk:' || (day)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 10) < 4 THEN 1 WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('dk:' || (day)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 10) = 4 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS k FROM days
),
base AS (
    SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.day, s.j) AS i, c.day
    FROM counts c CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, c.k) AS s(j)
)
SELECT
    'OZ9' || lpad(i::text, 6, '0') AS id,
    to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS opened,
    CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('dl:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 60 THEN 'A350' WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('dl:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 90 THEN 'A330' ELSE 'A320' END AS line,
    'Poste fictif ' || (1 + (('x' || substr(md5('ds:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 6))::text AS station,
    (1030000000 + i * 37)::text AS work_order,
    (CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('dm:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 10) < 5 THEN 30 WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('dm:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 10) < 8 THEN 15 + (('x' || substr(md5('dm2:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 30) ELSE 60 + (('x' || substr(md5('dm3:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 120) END)::double precision AS minutes,
    CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('de:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 18 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS in_block,
    CASE WHEN (('x' || substr(md5('de:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 100) < 18 THEN 'erma' ELSE '' END AS reason,
    'Closed' AS status,
    'Fictif : ' || (ARRAY['câble abîmé au montage', 'connecteur endommagé', 'pièce non conforme reçue', 'repère manquant', 'gaine déchirée'])[1 + (('x' || substr(md5('dc:' || (i)::text), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int % 5)]
        || ', repris sur place sans NC.' AS comment
FROM base
ORDER BY id
